Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Creation
Topic 1.1: Self-awareness

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Self-awareness, part of Creation in Grade 3 HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.
